1.question: How do I book an appointment?
1.answer: You can book an appointment through our website, by calling the respective clinic directly, or using our online booking system. Walk-in appointments are also available for urgent cases.

2.question: What insurance do you accept?
2.answer: We accept all major Swiss health insurance providers. Both basic (KVG) and supplementary insurance plans are welcome. Please bring your insurance card to your first visit.

3.question: What are the opening hours?
3.answer: Our clinics are generally open Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 18:00. Some locations offer Saturday morning hours. Please check individual clinic pages for specific times.

4.question: Do I need a referral?
4.answer: For general practice consultations, no referral is needed. For specialist services, a referral from your general practitioner may be required depending on your insurance model.

5.question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
5.answer: Please bring your health insurance card, a valid ID, any relevant medical records, a list of current medications, and any referral letters if applicable.

6.question: Do you offer emergency services?
6.answer: Yes, several of our clinics offer walk-in emergency services during opening hours. For life-threatening emergencies, please call 144 (Swiss emergency number).

7.question: Can I get my lab results online?
7.answer: Lab results are typically discussed with your doctor during a follow-up consultation. We are implementing a patient portal for digital access to results.

8.question: Are your clinics wheelchair accessible?
8.answer: Yes, all our clinics are designed to be fully accessible, including wheelchair access, accessible parking, and adapted facilities.

9.question: How can I cancel an appointment?
9.answer: Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance by calling the clinic directly. Late cancellations or no-shows may incur a fee.

10.question: Do you offer telemedicine?
10.answer: Yes, we offer video consultations through our telemedicine platform. Book online or call any clinic to schedule a virtual appointment.

11.question: What languages do your doctors speak?
11.answer: Our multilingual team speaks German, English, French, Italian, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese, and Mandarin, depending on the doctor.

12.question: Do you treat children?
12.answer: Yes, our general practices provide pediatric care for children of all ages. For specialized pediatric care, we can provide appropriate referrals.

radiology.name: X-Ray Examination
radiology.shortDescription: Modern digital X-ray diagnostics for precise and fast findings directly at the practice.
radiology.longDescription: Our modern X-ray equipment provides comprehensive imaging diagnostics – fast and precise, without external referral.

cardiology.name: Heart Examination (ECG)
cardiology.shortDescription: Comprehensive cardiological diagnostics – ECG, stress tests, and heart health checks.
cardiology.longDescription: Our cardiological services include ECG, stress tests, and preventive heart health checks for optimal cardiac health.

pulmonology.name: Lung Examinations
pulmonology.shortDescription: Spirometry and pulmonary function tests for complete respiratory assessment.
pulmonology.longDescription: Our pulmonary diagnostics include spirometry and additional lung function tests for conditions such as asthma, COPD, and other respiratory diseases.

laboratory.name: Laboratory & Diagnostics
laboratory.shortDescription: In-house laboratory with fast results for blood tests and comprehensive diagnostics.
laboratory.longDescription: Our modern in-house laboratory offers comprehensive blood tests, urine analyses, and other diagnostic services with minimal waiting times.

beautyTreatments.name: Aesthetic Medicine
beautyTreatments.shortDescription: Non-invasive and minimally invasive aesthetic treatments at MedEsthec – Botox & fillers, laser, body contouring, and vaginal rejuvenation.
beautyTreatments.longDescription: MedEsthec offers a comprehensive range of aesthetic medical treatments under the medical supervision of Dr. med. Demaili Fiknete. Services include: Hyaluronic acid fillers (lips, cheeks, jawline, tear troughs), Botulinum Toxin / Botox, RF Microneedling & CO₂ Laser (SecretPro), Biorevitalization & Skinboosters, Mesotherapy, Hyaluronidase correction, Endolifting, Sculptra & Biostimulators, Radiofrequency SECTUM, Polynucleotides, permanent laser hair removal, Vaginal Rejuvenation, personalised DR. FIDEM DRIPs (nutrient infusions), and medical skincare with ZO® Skin Health.

pharmacy.name: In-House Pharmacy
pharmacy.shortDescription: Direct medication dispensing at the practice – convenient after your consultation.
pharmacy.longDescription: Our in-house pharmacy allows immediate medication dispensing after consultation – for maximum convenience and fast care.

preventiveCare.name: Prevention & Wellness
preventiveCare.shortDescription: Proactive health prevention and screening programs for your long-term health.
preventiveCare.longDescription: Prevention is better than cure. Our prevention programs include comprehensive health screenings, vaccination programs, and personalised wellness plans.

emergency.name: Emergency Care
emergency.shortDescription: Walk-in emergency care for acute illnesses without long waiting times.
emergency.longDescription: Our practices offer emergency care for acute illnesses. Our experienced team handles a wide range of emergencies with professionalism and care.

ironTherapy.name: Iron Deficiency Therapy
ironTherapy.shortDescription: Specialized iron infusions for fatigue and iron deficiency – quick and effective.
ironTherapy.longDescription: Our iron infusion therapy treats fatigue and exhaustion caused by iron deficiency. Under medical supervision, you receive an effective intravenous iron treatment.

earCleaning.name: Ear Irrigation
earCleaning.shortDescription: Professional ear cleaning by experienced specialists.
earCleaning.longDescription: Our professional ear irrigation removes cerumen plugs and restores optimal hearing function – quickly, safely, and painlessly.

drivingFitness.name: Driving Fitness Assessment
drivingFitness.shortDescription: Medical assessment of driving fitness according to Swiss legal requirements.
drivingFitness.longDescription: We conduct medical driving fitness assessments according to the requirements of the Road Traffic Office – reliably and on time.

naturalMedicineLongevity.name: Natural Medicine & Longevity
naturalMedicineLongevity.shortDescription: Preventive vitality therapies for longevity – IV infusions, NAD+, ozone therapy, peptides, red light, PEMF and hormone optimisation.
naturalMedicineLongevity.longDescription: Our Longevity and Natural Medicine programme combines evidence-based preventive medicine with modern vitality therapies. We offer: high-dose Vitamin C infusions, NAD+ infusions, Glutathione, amino acids, vitamin shots (B12, D3, B-complex), Ozone Autohemotherapy, PRP Autologous Blood Therapy, Peptide Therapy, Red Light Therapy, PEMF Therapy, and micronutrient therapy. We also offer specialised programmes for stress & burnout, Long-Covid, hormone optimisation, and individual nutritional and lifestyle coaching.

longDescriptions.seefeld: Hausarztpraxis Seefeld has been serving the Seefeld community for over 15 years. Our team of experienced general practitioners provides comprehensive medical services in a modern, welcoming environment – from routine check-ups to urgent care.
longDescriptions.duebendorf: Our clinic in Dübendorf combines years of medical experience with modern technology. We specialize in family medicine and offer a broad range of services – from routine examinations to emergency care.
longDescriptions.altstetten: In the vibrant Altstetten neighbourhood, we offer comprehensive primary care with extended diagnostic capabilities. Our on-site pharmacy and X-ray equipment enable fast and efficient patient care.
longDescriptions.winterthur: Our clinic in Winterthur provides high-quality family medicine in a warm, professional environment. We place great emphasis on long-term patient relationships and individually tailored care.
longDescriptions.wald: Praxis Felsenau in Wald takes a personal approach to healthcare in a relaxed, community-oriented atmosphere. Our team focuses on prevention and the well-being of every individual patient.
longDescriptions.medesthec: MedEsthec is our premium centre for aesthetic medicine, offering cutting-edge treatments for beauty and rejuvenation. Our specialist team combines medical expertise with an artistic eye for natural, refined results.
longDescriptions.beauty-altstetten: Our beauty clinic in Altstetten offers an extensive portfolio of aesthetic treatments in a luxurious, relaxed atmosphere – from non-invasive skin treatments to advanced cosmetic procedures.
longDescriptions.naturheilmedizin: Our natural medicine centre combines traditional healing methods with modern medical knowledge. We offer a comprehensive range of complementary therapies to support natural self-healing and holistic health promotion.
longDescriptions.urohealth: UroHealth is our specialised urology centre with a full range of urological services. Our experienced urologists use state-of-the-art technology for diagnosis and treatment.
longDescriptions.jerumed-shop: Jerumed Shop is your trusted online destination for pharmaceutical products, medical supplies and wellness items. We offer a curated selection of high-quality health products with convenient delivery throughout Switzerland.
